text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I thought I heard someone calling my name from around here…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Could it have been one of my fans? Did I miss them somehow?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Three Goddesses! Did you happen to see anyone over here?
